reviews.text:
My thanks to employee VERA for the kindness and professionalism shown, for her availability, patience, knowledge and, above all, her ability to convey confidence and tranquility. With admirable clarity and dedication, she answered questions, explained, guided and taught.
Professionals like her make a difference and deserve to be recognized.
Thank you very much for everything.
The most competent and humane veterinarians there are. As caring for the animals as they are for their owners 🙂 …

I want to express my gratitude to the VetPlanet team, especially Dr. Nelson.

I took my Ralph for a consultation and the experience was excellent from beginning to end.

Dr. Nelson was extremely attentive and dedicated. He examined Ralph with great care, weighed him, palpated him, asked all the questions about his routine, and explained each step of the treatment clearly.

It was clear that he truly cares about animals and doesn't do anything "just for the sake of doing it."

The clinic is clean, organized, and the reception service was also great.

I left feeling much more at ease. I found a new, trustworthy veterinarian for Ralph.

I highly recommend VetPlanet Benfica! Thank you!
Always a careful, thorough, and attentive service.
The staff and veterinarians were very attentive and helpful.
Lots of kind people, ready to help, small but comfortable space for our four-legged friends.

They are truly amazing in the way they treat, accompany, listen to, and care for our animals.
Thank you for everything you do ❤️🐾 …

Female dog, 13 months old.
We went in an emergency situation on a Saturday late afternoon (stick lodged in the roof of her mouth). Very quick service, with quality and friendliness.

Our animals have always been very well treated, with all the attention and affection.

Thank you to this fantastic team. Very grateful.
Super attentive, caring, and professional 🙏 I couldn't recommend them more! Thank you for all the support, care, and affection ♥️🐶 …

Hello Alicia Zavalis,

Thank you so much for your rating.

We are very happy!

Thank you very much and see you soon, Vet Planet Group
The whole team is very professional and attentive.

Some of the reception staff are very unfriendly. When a customer arrives, if there are two employees present, the one available doesn't have the slightest initiative to help. Don't they understand that customers are important...?
